author: Bellular News
description:
Destiny 2 is getting its final content update, but Bungie’s announcement was only the clean version. Staff reports now point to no Destiny 3 in development, no greenlit successor, looming layoffs, and a studio that kept even its own people in the dark until the end.

Join us at http://bellular.games for early access content, 20 editions of 'Loading Screen' a month and to support our team!
